EXPERT SHOWER REPAIR SERVICES IN LONDON

A dripping shower head, sudden cold bursts, or water pressure issues can disrupt your daily routine and often require a skilled plumber to resolve the problem. A faulty shower does not always necessitate a full replacement – many problems can be resolved with professional repairs. At Maintracts Services, our experienced team quickly identifies the fault and delivers honest, cost-effective, and reliable shower repair solutions. All work is carried out by experienced, fully equipped plumbers based in London. Clear pricing is provided before repairs begin, and where parts are required, we source and install the correct valves, cartridges, seal kits, or pumps. Need help now? Contact us now to arrange a priority shower repair visit anywhere in London. 

TYPES OF SHOWERS WE REPAIR IN LONDON

With decades of experience since 1974, Maintracts has successfully repaired every type of shower system found in homes and rental properties throughout London. Each shower type comes with its common faults, and our team is equipped with the right expertise to handle them all. 

Electric showers – These require expert attention due to their electrical components and safety requirements. Electric showers heat water instantly using a built-in element, which can fail due to mineral buildup, faulty thermostats, or wiring issues. Our qualified plumbers and engineers ensure that all repairs meet the highest electrical safety standards. 
Mixer showers – Known for combining hot and cold water to create a steady temperature, mixer showers can suffer from worn-out cartridges, leaks, or fluctuating temperatures. We specialise in mixer shower repair, ensuring reliable operation. 
Power showers – Designed to improve water flow and pressure, power showers can face issues with pumps, valves, or pressure imbalances. Our team provides complete power shower maintenance and repair solutions to restore optimal performance.

FAQS – SHOWER REPAIRS IN LONDON
How much does a shower repair cost in London?

The cost of shower repair in London depends on the issue, the type of shower, and any parts required. At Maintracts, we provide transparent pricing with no hidden fees. Call 020 8682 2244 for a quick quote. 

Can you fix a leaking shower head without replacing it?

Yes, in many cases, a leaking shower head can be fixed by replacing worn washers, seals, or O-rings rather than changing the entire head. Our plumbers will diagnose the issue and offer the most cost-effective solution.

What causes low water pressure in a shower?

Low water pressure is often caused by a blocked showerhead, a faulty pump, or issues with the water supply. Our team can investigate and fix water pressure problems to restore a steady flow.

How quickly can Maintracts respond to shower emergencies?

We offer rapid response times across London. In most cases, we can reach you on the same day to repair leaks, clear blockages, or address other urgent shower issues.

Do you repair electric showers safely?

Absolutely. Our qualified engineers are trained to handle electric shower repairs safely and ensure all work complies with UK electrical standards.
